name: bcal-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server and VS Code bridge for Business Central AL workflows.

scripts.build: bun run clean && mkdir -p server/dist vscode-bridge/dist && bun build server/src/index.ts --outfile server/dist/index.js --target bun && bun build vscode-bridge/src/extension.ts --outfile vscode-bridge/dist/extension.js --target node --external vscode
